an4.171:3.1: By oneself one instigates the verbal choice, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself;
an4.171:3.2: Or else others instigate the verbal choice;
an4.171:3.3: conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself;
an4.171:3.4: One instigates the verbal choice after deliberation, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself;
an4.171:3.5: Or else one instigates the verbal choice without deliberation, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself.
an4.171:4.1: By oneself one instigates the mental choice, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself;
an4.171:4.2: Or else others instigate the mental choice, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself;
an4.171:4.3: One instigates the mental choice after deliberation, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself;
an4.171:4.4: Or else one instigates the mental choice without deliberation, conditioned by which that pleasure and pain arise in oneself.
